title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30649v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers

translated_title: 身份信息藏身何处：多模态大语言模型中的局部化、无需保留集的身份遗忘
translated_abstract: 从多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中移除特定个体的信息在部署后常常是必要的，但现有方法依赖于保留集，而这在部署后恰恰最难获得，且重建保留集会重新引入隐私暴露问题——这正是遗忘技术想要消除的。仅凭遗忘集进行遗忘则会破坏共享的视觉-语言计算，损害感知能力。我们将无需保留集的遗忘转化为一个定位问题：因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠分析均指向解码器中早期至中期的MLP层——身份信息存储于此，且与其他模块不同，修改这些层不会显著干扰视觉能力。我们据此提出了路径感知视觉属性锚定（PAVA），该方法将更新严格限制在这些层内，并将遗忘损失与视觉属性锚定相结合，通过蒸馏模型自身在遗忘前的回答来保持基于图像的行为。
tldr: 该论文发现多模态大语言模型中的身份信息主要存储于解码器早期至中期的MLP层，并提出PAVA方法，通过仅修改这些层并以视觉属性锚定保留图像理解能力，实现了无需保留集且不损害视觉感知的身份遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper localizes identity information in early-to-mid decoder MLPs of MLLMs and proposes PAVA, which confines updates to these layers with a visual-attribute anchor to achieve retain-free identity unlearning without harming visual perception.
